title: FOCoOp: Enhancing Out-of-Distribution Robustness in Federated Prompt Learning for Vision-Language Models
caption: Figure 2: Framework of FOCoOp. For each client, FOCoOp uses bi-level OOD separations module to fine-tune three sets of prompts adapting to pretrained VLM. While in the server, FOCoOp leverages the global-view OOD consistency module to enhance the discrimination among ID global prompts and OOD prompts.
